gas density: within 2.2 % of the reference up to 2000 kPa(a) except at isolated states where DWSIM 9.0.5 returns a wrong vapour density while its enthalpy agrees (air at 260 K, 200 kPa(a): -3.6 %; nitrogen-oxygen 50/50 at 250 K, 700 kPa(a): -32 %; crude oxygen at 190 K, 300 kPa(a): -20 %); up to 5 % at 170 K and 6000 kPa(a); at 170 K and 10000 kPa(a) DWSIM labels supercritical oxygen and argon liquid and its Rackett density is wrong by orders of magnitude

cases.description: Design case: net 2.0 t/h MMA, 4.4 t/h DMA, 1.6 t/h TMA (D-002), converter feed N/C 2.0, outlet 713 K (D-004)

design_basis: Converter: adiabatic fixed bed of amorphous silica-alumina, inlet 625 K / 2200 kPa(a), outlet 713 K / 2000 kPa(a); window 350-450 C and 150-350 psig from US 3,387,032 A and US 4,283,254 A (D-004).

Converter outlet at the ideal-gas equilibrium of the three methylations at the outlet temperature, ATcT/CRC/Poling data; a model basis, not kinetics (D-005). Checked against the published equilibrium at 400 C, N/C 2.0 (US 4,485,261 A): TMA under-predicted (0.37 vs 0.43 by weight among the amines, D-005).
Converter feed N/C ratio 2.0 (mol N / mol methyl carbon), ASSUMED inside the ranges of US 7,435,855 B2 and US 4,485,261 A (D-004).
All ammonia and the TMA recycle return as the ammonia column distillate; MMA beyond the product rate and unconverted methanol are recycled (D-007).
Columns are sharp splits; reflux ratios, pressures, extraction water ratio 1 kg/kg and a minimum boil-up of 0.1 kmol/kmol bottoms are ASSUMED (D-008).
No by-products (dimethyl ether, higher amines, CO/H2 from decomposition, coke), no inert purge and no caustic dosing modelled (D-005, D-008).
Duties are concept estimates (ideal gas + heats of vaporisation, no mixing enthalpy), +/-30 % at best; no heat integration beyond the feed/effluent exchanger (D-006, D-009).
